BROWSER.description: Playwright Browser Automation: Navigate web pages, click elements, fill forms, extract reader DOM and capture screenshots.

commands.click_element: Clicks a page element by its visible text label or CSS selector.
commands.close: Closes the entire Hecos AI browser window.
commands.close_tab: Closes the currently active browser tab.
commands.get_current_url: Returns the URL currently loaded in the Hecos browser.
commands.get_inputs: Lists all input fields, buttons and form elements on the current page.
commands.get_links: Returns all hyperlinks on the current page as a numbered list.
commands.get_page_text: Returns all visible text from the current browser page.
commands.get_title: Returns the title of the current browser page.
commands.go_back: Navigate the browser back to the previous page.
commands.list_tabs: List all open tabs/pages in the current browser.
commands.new_tab: Opens a new tab in the browser.
commands.open_url: Opens a URL in the Hecos AI browser. If the browser is already running, opens a new tab.
commands.press_key: Presses a keyboard key in the browser context.
commands.run_js: Executes JavaScript in the browser and returns the result.
commands.screenshot: Takes a screenshot of the current browser viewport.
commands.scroll: Scrolls the browser page up or down.
commands.switch_tab: Switches the active browser focus to a specific tab by its ID.
commands.type_in_field: Finds an input field and types text into it.

BROWSER.routing_instructions: Use BROWSER to interact with a live browser session: open URLs, click buttons, fill forms, scroll pages, capture screenshots and automate UI interactions.

BUILDER.description: Builder Studio: Visual IDE for building and managing Hecos packages.

commands.get_backend_status: Verifies if the AI backend (Ollama, Kobold, or Cloud) is online and ready.
commands.get_full_dashboard: Returns a complete report of all hardware resources and AI backend status.
commands.get_gpu_status: Returns the video card (GPU) status, including VRAM usage and thermal/computational load.
commands.get_system_resources: Returns a summary of system CPU and RAM usage.

commands.count_items: Counts the total number of files and folders in a given path.
commands.get_root: Returns the configured root directory for the drive.
commands.list_files: SCANS and lists files/folders in a path to return the names to the AI.
commands.read_file: Reads the textual content of a file.

EXECUTOR.description: Safe Python execution (AST Sandbox), system control, and file management. Absorbs AutoCoder.

commands.run_python_code: Execute Python safely in AST sandbox.
commands.execute_background_command: Run shell commands in background for long tasks.
commands.execute_slash_command: Executes an HDCS direct slash command.
commands.get_battery_status: Device battery level and charging state.
commands.read_file: Read a file content by line range.
commands.write_file: Write or create a file (overwrite or append).
commands.patch_file: Surgically replace a text block inside a file.
commands.set_important_path: Memorize an important directory path for the user (e.g., user_profile, downloads).
commands.get_important_paths: Get all important paths memorized by the user, and the default workspace.

HELP.description: Displays the list of all active commands and modules in the system.

commands.list_capabilities: Displays the complete list of all tools, modules, and capabilities currently loaded in the system.
commands.refresh_registry: Forces a re-read and update of the central capabilities registry (rescans plugins).

MEMORY.description: Access to the Vault of memories and Admin profile (Identity and History). Includes RAG vector memory for long-term semantic recall.

commands.read_history: Extract the last N saved messages from the database history.
commands.remember_info: Save important information about the user in the biographical profile.
commands.reset_memory: Execute the Tabula Rasa protocol: clear the entire episodic chat history.
commands.who_am_i: Ask Hecos to retrieve identity data for the Admin and the AI (context profile).
commands.rag_search: Perform a semantic search in the long-term vector memory (RAG knowledge base).
commands.rag_store: Store a piece of information permanently in the vector knowledge base.
commands.rag_ingest_file: Ingest a local file (.txt, .md, .pdf) into the vector knowledge base.

MODELS.description: Changes the AI model based on the active backend (Ollama/Kobold).

commands.get_current_backend: Returns the AI backend currently in use (e.g., cloud, ollama, kobold).
commands.list_models: Lists all available models for the currently selected backend.
commands.set_model: Sets a new active AI model based on the numeric index obtained from list_models.

NETSEARCH.description: Net Search: Multi-engine Web, Tor DarkWeb (.onion), OSINT, Media and Deep File Intelligence.

commands.dark_search: Searches the Tor Dark Web (.onion hidden services) through Ahmia, TorDex, Phobos, and onion crawlers.
commands.deep_search: Deep uninhibited search aggregating Clear Web, Dark Web (.onion), and file hunting.
commands.fetch_page: Reads and extracts the textual content of any webpage (Clearnet or Tor .onion).
commands.file_search: Hunts for downloadable files and documents using multi-extension dork queries and Archive.org.
commands.media_search: Searches for images, videos, audio and podcasts matching the query.
commands.osint_search: OSINT identity hunt: finds active user profiles across 15+ social and coding platforms.
commands.web_search: Searches the Clearnet using privacy-preserving aggregators (SearXNG, DuckDuckGo, Brave, etc.).

NETSEARCH.routing_instructions:
NET SEARCH & INTELLIGENCE EXECUTION RULES:

1. WEB SEARCH: If the user asks to search the web, find news, or search anything online, call NETSEARCH__web_search(query=...).
2. DARK WEB: If the user asks for Tor, .onion, hidden services, dark web, or uninhibited search, call NETSEARCH__dark_search(query=...).
3. DEEP SEARCH: If the user asks for comprehensive / deep search combining Clear + Dark + Files, call NETSEARCH__deep_search(query=...).
4. MEDIA SEARCH: If the user asks for images, videos, audio/soundtracks, call NETSEARCH__media_search(query=..., media_type=...).
5. FILE SEARCH: If the user asks for documents, PDFs, ebooks, zip archives, or file downloads, call NETSEARCH__file_search(query=..., file_types=...).
6. OSINT: If the user asks to find a person's online accounts, usernames, or social profiles, call NETSEARCH__osint_search(username=...).
7. READ WEBPAGE: If the user asks to inspect, read, or scrape a specific URL (clearnet or .onion), call NETSEARCH__fetch_page(url=...).

commands.list_souls: Elenca tutte le personalità (souls) attualmente disponibili nel sistema.
commands.switch_soul: Cambia la personalità attiva. Accetta sia il nome esatto (es. "Motoko") sia l'indice numerico.

commands.open_browser: Opens the Hecos web interface in the default browser if not already open.

CALENDAR.description: Core calendar module for Hecos. Stores, displays, and manages time-based events. Provides a shared datetime picker UI component, LLM tools, and REST API for other modules.

commands.add_event: Adds an event to the calendar.
commands.delete_event: Deletes a calendar event by ID.
commands.get_date_info: Gets current date context, including localized formatting and upcoming holidays.

slash_commands.description: Lists the upcoming events in the calendar

commands.generate_pdf: Converts HTML content to a PDF file and returns the file path.
commands.list_documents: Lists all documents in the documents folder.
commands.list_images: Lists available images in media/images and media/generated_photos that can be reused in documents.
commands.modify_document: Modifies an existing HTML document (add images, replace sections, change layout).
commands.optimize_layout: Calculates page breaks for a document and returns a report of elements split across pages.

commands.list_documents: List all documents (PDF, TXT, MD, HTML, DOCX) available in the documents library.
commands.read_document: Open a document in the fullscreen reader with TTS capabilities. Accepts filename, partial name, or full path.

TEMPLATES.description: Centralized template manager for communications (Mail, WhatsApp, Telegram).

LISTS.description: Create and manage multiple lists (e.g. groceries, todos) with Hecos. Supports custom colors, archived lists, item states, and LLM autonomous management.

commands.list_lists: Shows all active lists with the count of items.
commands.show_list: Shows all items of a specific list.
commands.add_to_list: Adds one or more items to a list. Creates the list if it doesn't exist.
commands.check_item: Marks an item as completed in a list.
commands.remove_from_list: Permanently deletes an item from a list.
commands.clear_done: Removes all completed items from a list.
commands.archive_list: Archives a list (hides it from the main view).

MESSENGER.description: Send messages via Telegram, WhatsApp, and Discord.

commands.register_pre_callback: Registra un pre-callback che intercetta i messaggi in ingresso.
commands.resolve_contact_address: Looks up a contact in the address book and returns their platform-specific address (e.g., chat ID).
commands.send_message: Send a message to a contact or channel.
commands.send_photo: Send a photo to a contact or channel (Telegram only for now).

AUTOMATION.description: PC Automation: control the mouse, keyboard, and application windows. Use with desktop_screenshot for a full see-and-act loop.

commands.click: Clicks the mouse at the given screen coordinates.
commands.click_text: Locates text on the screen via OCR and clicks it.
commands.drag: Clicks and drags from one position to another.
commands.focus_browser_tab: Clicks on a browser tab whose title contains the given text fragment (case-insensitive).
commands.focus_window: Brings a window to the foreground by partial title match.
commands.get_browser_tabs: Returns the titles of all currently open tabs in Chrome, Edge, Opera, or Brave.
commands.get_mouse_position: Returns the current mouse cursor coordinates (x, y).
commands.get_screen_size: Returns the screen resolution (width x height in pixels).
commands.hotkey: Executes a keyboard shortcut by holding multiple keys simultaneously.
commands.list_windows: Returns a list of all currently visible window titles.
commands.maximize_window: Maximizes a window by partial title match.
commands.minimize_window: Minimizes a window by partial title match.
commands.move_to: Moves the mouse cursor to the specified screen coordinates.
commands.press_key: Presses and releases a single key.
commands.read_window_controls: Reads the UI control tree (buttons, inputs, links) of an application window.
commands.scroll: Scrolls the mouse wheel at the specified position.
commands.type_and_enter: Types the given text and immediately presses Enter.
commands.type_text: Types the given text as simulated keystrokes.

AUTOMATION.routing_instructions: VISION/AUTOMATION SYNERGY: You DO have 'eyes'! You can interact with the user's screen. When asked to click on something or read the screen, FIRST call WEBCAM__desktop_screenshot. The system will return the image to your context. THEN analyze the image to find the exact (x, y) coordinates. FINALLY, call AUTOMATION__move_to or AUTOMATION__click with those coordinates.

REMINDER.description: Schedule time-based reminders with TTS alerts and WebUI notifications. Supports natural language and recurring CRON expressions.

commands.set_reminder: Creates a reminder. Fires TTS + WebUI alert at the specified time.
commands.list_reminders: Lists all active reminders with their scheduled time and ID.
commands.cancel_reminder: Cancels an active reminder by ID.
commands.snooze_reminder: Postpones a reminder by N minutes from now.
